scenes.say: Similar incidents, different penalties? From twenty twenty-seven, Formula One gets full-time stewards.
Today stewards rotate through the races and work mostly as volunteers.
The FIA announced it on the nineteenth of November, during Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend.
A small first group is recruited in twenty twenty-seven, and the programme grows from twenty twenty-eight.
The long-term goal is a department of twelve to fifteen full-time stewards.
Current stewards stay. So does the former racing driver on each panel.
Between races, the full-time stewards will spot trends and rules that need clarifying.
They will also train future officials and may later support other FIA series.
In October the FIA opened a remote centre at Biggin Hill. The stewards still make the decisions.
Follow race control messages and live races on the LapRadar map.

title: F1 to get full-time stewards from 2027
